text:
alex: FYI we're seeing OTLP exporter stalls in prod - span queue climbs and goroutine blocks.
mira: same, noticed a pattern around a gRPC stream close -> backlog grows for ~30s then OOM-ish backpressure.
alex: last log from the collector side: "STREAM_FAIL: rpc stream closed: broken pipe" + repeated reconnects.
seb: sounds like streaming windowing + per-call deadlines interacting poorly. What are current exporter configs?
mira: current: per_rpc_deadline=30s, retry.max_attempts=4, backoff.base=200ms max=6s, enable_unary_fallback=false
julie: had a hunch about in-flight batch sizes. If streaming_window is huge, a single stream failure forces retransmit of a ton of spans.
seb: propose: enforce streaming_window_bytes=256KB, add per_attempt_timeout (shorter than per_rpc_deadline), and enable unary fallback for short windows.
alex: unary fallback solves availability but changes semantics (ordering/duplicates). Need idempotency header support.
julie: agree - require x-otel-id header on export so server can dedupe when fallback triggers.
mira: here's a sketch of the config I want to try:
```yaml
exporters:
  otlp:
    endpoint: collector.redwood.internal:4317
    protocol: grpc
    per_rpc_deadline: 30s
    per_attempt_timeout: 5s
    retry:
      enabled: true
      max_attempts: 5
      backoff:
        base_interval: 100ms
        max_interval: 5s
        jitter: true
    streaming_window_bytes: 262144
    enable_unary_fallback: true
    idempotency_header: "x-otel-id"
```
seb: also tune gRPC keepalive and max_concurrent_streams on the collector/proxy. Envoy defaults can be too low/high depending on mix.
alex: good call. On envoy we saw spiky stream churn when concurrent streams > 200 then transient errors.
julie: logs from yesterday for context:
```
2026-01-18T12:04:09Z collector: accepted stream conn_id=abcd
2026-01-18T12:04:39Z collector: stream closed conn_id=abcd reason=broken_pipe
2026-01-18T12:04:40Z exporter: retrying batch id=xyz attempts=1
2026-01-18T12:05:10Z exporter: backlog_size=118743 spans
```
mira: we should add metrics before rolling: otlp.exporter.stream_reconnects, otlp.exporter.unary_fallback_count, otlp.exporter.backpressure_latency.
julie: rollout plan: PR -> canary on 10% traffic -> monitor metrics/trace loss -> bump to 50% then 100% if green.
otel-bot: Deploy job queued: https://ci.redwood.internal/jenkins/job/otlp-config/4521
alex: also add runbook note for on-call: how to flip enable_unary_fallback=false quickly if fallback causes downstream issues.
mira: I'll open the PR with the config + metrics + runbook. tagging seb & julie for review.
seb: sgtm, will review; check collector side for dedupe handling of x-otel-id.
julie: canary tomorrow morning US-west. marking P2.
alex: thanks — appreciate the fast turnaround. :thumbsup:
